6: from __future__ import annotations

8: from dataclasses import dataclass, field

11: @dataclass(frozen=True, order=True)
12: class Point:
13:     x: int
14:     y: int
15: 
16:     def shift(self, dx: int, dy: int) -> "Point":
17:         return Point(self.x + dx, self.y + dy)
18: 
19:     def manhattan(self, other: "Point") -> int:
20:         return abs(self.x - other.x) + abs(self.y - other.y)
21: 
22:     def neighbors4(self) -> tuple["Point", ...]:
23:         return (self.shift(0, -1), self.shift(1, 0),
24:                 self.shift(0, 1), self.shift(-1, 0))
25: 
26: 
27: @dataclass
28: class Actor:
29:     actor_id: str
30:     pos: Point
31:     hp: int
32:     max_hp: int
33:     attack: int
34:     faction: str
35:     glyph: str
36:     alive: bool = True
37:     statuses: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)

39:     def __post_init__(self):
40:         if self.max_hp < 1 or self.hp < 0 or self.attack < 0:
41:             raise ValueError("invalid actor statistics")
42:         self.hp = min(self.hp, self.max_hp)
43:         self.alive = self.hp > 0
44: 
45:     def move_to(self, point: Point):
46:         if not self.alive:
47:             raise ValueError("dead actors cannot move")
48:         self.pos = point
49: 
50:     def heal(self, amount: int) -> int:
51:         if amount < 0:
52:             raise ValueError("negative healing")
53:         old = self.hp
54:         self.hp = min(self.max_hp, self.hp + amount)
55:         self.alive = self.hp > 0
56:         return self.hp - old
57: 
58:     def receive(self, amount: int) -> int:
59:         if amount < 0:
60:             raise ValueError("negative damage")
61:         dealt = min(self.hp, amount)

1: """Versioned JSON save format. Version 1 preserves deterministic world state."""
2: from __future__ import annotations
3: 
4: import json
5: from pathlib import Path
6: 
7: from .inventory import Bag
8: from .model import Actor, Event, Item, Point, World
9: 
10: SAVE_VERSION = 1
11: 
12: 
13: def encode(world: World, bags: dict[str, Bag]) -> dict:
14:     return {
15:         "version": SAVE_VERSION,
16:         "width": world.width,
17:         "height": world.height,
18:         "walls": [[p.x, p.y] for p in sorted(world.walls)],
19:         "actors": [{
20:             "actor_id": a.actor_id, "pos": [a.pos.x, a.pos.y], "hp": a.hp,
21:             "max_hp": a.max_hp, "attack": a.attack, "faction": a.faction,
22:             "glyph": a.glyph, "statuses": a.statuses,
23:         } for a in sorted(world.actors.values(), key=lambda a: a.actor_id)],
24:         "items": [{"pos": [p.x, p.y], "items": [vars(item) for item in stack]}
25:                   for p, stack in sorted(world.items.items())],
26:         "bags": {aid: {"capacity": bag.capacity,
27:                        "items": [vars(item) for item in bag.items]}
28:                  for aid, bag in sorted(bags.items())},
29:         "turn": world.turn,
30:         "events": [vars(event) for event in world.events],
31:     }
32: 
33: 
34: def decode(data: dict) -> tuple[World, dict[str, Bag]]:
35:     if data.get("version") != SAVE_VERSION:
36:         raise ValueError("unsupported save version")
37:     world = World(data["width"], data["height"])
38:     world.walls = {Point(*p) for p in data["walls"]}
39:     for row in data["actors"]:
40:         actor = Actor(row["actor_id"], Point(*row["pos"]), row["hp"],
41:                       row["max_hp"], row["attack"], row["faction"], row["glyph"])
42:         actor.statuses = dict(row["statuses"])
43:         world.actors[actor.actor_id] = actor
44:     for row in data["items"]:
45:         world.items[Point(*row["pos"])] = [Item(**item) for item in row["items"]]
46:     bags = {aid: Bag(row["capacity"], [Item(**item) for item in row["items"]])
47:             for aid, row in data["bags"].items()}
48:     world.turn = data["turn"]
49:     world.events = [Event(**event) for event in data["events"]]
50:     return world, bags
51: 
52: 
53: def dumps(world: World, bags: dict[str, Bag]) -> str:
54:     return json.dumps(encode(world, bags), sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
55: 
56: 
57: def loads(payload: str) -> tuple[World, dict[str, Bag]]:
58:     return decode(json.loads(payload))
59: 
60: 
61: def save_file(path: Path, world: World, bags: dict[str, Bag]):
62:     path.write_text(dumps(world, bags), encoding="utf-8")
63: 
64: 
65: def load_file(path: Path) -> tuple[World, dict[str, Bag]]:
66:     return loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
